w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Olivia shakes their head, admiring. "Did you hear what Adaeze did?" You hadn't. Now you have.
Sofia waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Hungry Road with nothing. They'll remember the silence.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/8/5), with 5 wave-4 fought, 6 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 7 · Craft 5 · Talk 6 · Explore 25 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE WITNESS — "Offer them a way back."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Sofia Chen ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

ghostLines.line: 🚶 A woman, maybe 30s is back with Desiana.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
